thought.text: Role mapping uses POST, not PUT. Let me fix that.

reasoning_content:
For role mapping in the Keycloak admin REST API, we use POST instead of PUT for the composite role mapping endpoint:
POST /admin/realms/{realm}/users/{id}/role-mappings/clients/{client-uuid} with an array of role representations as the body.

Let's use POST.

action.command: TOK=$(cat /tmp/kc-token.txt) && UID1=acf1a53a-9e6e-4c76-a983-2dac22d10526 && CID=$(cat /tmp/client_id.txt) && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users/$UID1/role-mappings/clients/$CID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '[{"name":"app-access","composite":false,"clientRole":true,"containerId":"'$CID'"},{"name":"editor","composite":false,"clientRole":true,"containerId":"'$CID'"}]' -w "assign roles: HTTP:%{http_code}\n" && echo "=== verify user roles ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users/$UID1/role-mappings/clients/$CID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" | jq -r '.[].name'

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "TOK=$(cat /tmp/kc-token.txt) && UID1=acf1a53a-9e6e-4c76-a983-2dac22d10526 && CID=$(cat /tmp/client_id.txt) && curl -s -X POST \"http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users/$UID1/role-mappings/clients/$CID\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOK\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '[{\"name\":\"app-access\",\"composite\":false,\"clientRole\":true,\"containerId\":\"'$CID'\"},{\"name\":\"editor\",\"composite\":false,\"clientRole\":true,\"containerId\":\"'$CID'\"}]' -w \"assign roles: HTTP:%{http_code}\\n\" && echo \"=== verify user roles ===\" && curl -s \"http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users/$UID1/role-mappings/clients/$CID\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOK\" | jq -r '.[].name'", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Assign roles via POST and verify"}
